channel.title: horowitz.law: Treatment Corrections
channel.description: Adverse-treatment flags on published Georgia Appellate Watch cases. The sweep may only raise a flag to caution; negative and superseded are human determinations made on Shepard’s. The flagged card and the linked opinion are the authority.

item.title: Negative treatment: Aspen American Insurance Company v. Landstar Ranger, Inc.
item.description: Overruled in part by Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II, LLC, 146 S. Ct. 1199 (2026); Shepard's confirmed June 12, 2026. The safety-exception holding is gone — negligent-hiring claims against brokers survive under 49 U.S.C. § 14501(c)(2)(A). Montgomery assumed without deciding the § 14501(c)(1) preemption-scope point Aspen also decided, and Aspen arose from cargo theft rather than personal injury. Cited by: Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II, LLC; Willy Hodge v. Molson Coors Beverage Company USA, LLC. Verify on Shepard’s. Card: https://horowitz.law/o/9391147
